= Cloud August 7, 2026

[NOTE]
====
Kobiton now uses date-based release versioning. Instead of version numbers such as 4.26S or 4.19.3, releases are identified by the build date in YYYYMM.DD format. For example, 202608.07 represents a build created on August 7, 2026.

Cloud release notes are typically published weekly and summarize changes since the previous publication. +
Version information for individual software components is available in the Component versions section.
====

== Convert mixed (manual + automation) session to a Test Case

Completed mixed sessions that combine manual and Appium automation steps can now be converted into a Test Case. Previously, only manual-only or automation-only sessions could be converted into Test Cases.

*Highlights*

- The source session must be complete before it can be converted. Sessions that are still running are not eligible.
- The Test Case preserves the original recorded order across the manual and automation steps, and tags each step with its source (manual or automation).
- Convert from Session Explorer or from the *+New Test Case* pop-up on the Test Cases list page. Search for eligible sessions with the `type:mixed` keyword.
- Converted Test Cases show *Mixed* as the *Source type* on the Test Cases list.
- Test Runs for mixed Test Cases execute manual and automation steps in sequence, reporting pass/fail results for each step. If a step cannot be performed, such as an unsupported Appium command, it is skipped with a reason, and the Test Run continues.
- Appium script generation is not available for Test Cases converted from these sessions.

== Device details

- Fixed the *Apps* tab of the device modal reporting the newest version in the app repository as *Installed* instead of the build actually installed on the device. Android devices were affected when several builds of an app shared the same version.
- The app row on the *Apps* tab now shows *Installed* when any version of the app is installed, and names the installed build. Previously, the row reported the status of the newest version in the app repository.
- When the build on the device cannot be matched to a version in the app repository, no version is marked *Installed*. Previously, the newest version in the app repository was marked *Installed* in this case.

== Accessibility

- VoiceOver (iOS) and TalkBack (Android) audio now plays immediately when a session starts, and immediately after an app install. Previously, the audio stayed silent until the user tapped the device screen.

== Device passcode

- Fixed a passcode-requirement issue that prevented XCtest from being enabled on iOS devices. XCtest can now be enabled without the passcode blocking the workflow.
